topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outline the session's key learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and chromatin modifications confer selective growth advantages to expanding cellular clones.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue differentiation hierarchy and stemness properties dictate which cell types give rise to tumors.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Cancer Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and stromal interactions in the local microenvironment are required to promote and sustain malignant tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for Mapping Tumor Evolution and Spatial Heterogeneity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the genomic and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate clonal dynamics and cell-cell interactions in tumor tissue.

topics.label: Synthesis of Multifactorial Cancer Evolution and Concluding Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics integrate genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental influences into a unified evolutionary model of cancer and conclude the lecture.
